identity.description: Transcribes a recording and returns the strongest short-form clips with timestamps and captions.

inputs.description: Audio of you talking, under 25MB. Export audio-only rather than uploading video: an hour of speech fits comfortably at 64kbps mono. Short video clips are accepted too.

outputs.description: Three ranked clip suggestions with start and end timestamps, the quoted line, a caption, and why it works.

tags.name: Short-form clip selection
tags.description: Find the moments in a long recording that stand alone as a short video.
examples: Pull the three best 30-second cuts from a 20-minute model review
Find the strongest opening line in a screen recording
Turn a rambling demo walkthrough into captioned clip suggestions
